log: Act III, W3: the hermit's hut; a run from here has no Act I, II or morning behind it
the first ring: a fire and tea (the first rest sets the facet care, which the hermit reads)
offer one: the cup of tea on its stone before the door, taken with the first answer
the pebble with a hole by the hut's wall
the washing line with nothing on it: a trace of the world
he offers the stool and asks for nothing; with care the first answer is the invitation to the valley
the window, always the same; the pipe on its sill, taken
the second cup on its nail, never used
offer two and three: she sits on the stool; he plays the flute; the first answers stay three times
out again: the door stands open and nothing held her
